units.source_text: 宋金花决定了之后，无论山茶和迎春怎么劝说她，她都无动于衷，坚决不再接客。

en.t: After Song Jinhua had made up her mind, no matter how Shanchá and Yingchun tried to persuade her, she remained unmoved and firmly refused to receive any more customers.

units.source_text: 偶尔，熟悉的客人来她屋里找她玩耍，她也只是陪客人抽抽烟，但是绝不让客人上自己的床。

en.t: Sometimes familiar customers came to her room to spend time with her, and she would only sit with them and smoke, but she absolutely would not let them into her bed.
